issues_opened.title: ModelSettings.extra_args with a provider-native value aborts every Chat Completions model call with PydanticSerializationError
EncryptedSession.pop_item drains recoverable ciphertext when configured with the wrong key
RunState stringifies structured guardrail diagnostics and agent output during persistence
Tracing exporter honours OPENAI_API_KEY/ORG/PROJECT from the environment but not the endpoint, so OPENAI_BASE_URL does not redirect traces
OpenAIResponsesCompactionSession compacts only the SessionSettings.limit window and deletes the rest of the stored history
Issue draft (not filed): RunState stringifies structured `ToolCallOutputItem.custom_data` during persistence
BackendSpanExporter drops the whole batch on HTTP 429 instead of retrying with Retry-After
needs_approval misconfiguration raises in the core runner and silently skips approval in realtime sessions
Support skills for Agent and not just for SandboxAgent
Skills frontmatter parser mangles multi-line descriptions (folded >, literal |, wrapped lines) in the skill index
Chat Completions streaming: a reasoning item that arrives after the first text/tool chunk reuses output_index 0 and desynchronizes announced indexes from response.completed.output
function_schema treats a keyword-only RunContextWrapper first parameter as context, so every call to that tool raises a TypeError that is swallowed into the tool result
Cancelling a MCP server work task does not stop the worker
Realtime: close() keeps the previous connection's item and audio state, so a reconnect on the same model truncates and retrieves stale item ids
Realtime: a failing model.close() leaves every waiting event iterator blocked forever
Realtime: agent_end names the post-handoff agent instead of the agent whose turn ended
Voice: on Python 3.10 a streamed STT session-setup timeout escapes as asyncio.TimeoutError instead of STTWebsocketConnectionError
Example: AffixIO as a host-side tool guardrail
Agent.as_tool() nested subagent runs never hit prompt cache, even with byte-identical instructions/tools/prompt_cache_key
Local shell executor failure aborts the whole run instead of reaching the model
Modal sandbox: evaluate native filesystem APIs and clarify overwrite compatibility
Feature: memory portability across handoffs — verified memory bundles for agents and sessions
Generated translated docs (ja/ko/zh) contain ~30 broken relative links (translate_docs.py copies English link targets verbatim)
